svg.title: T02 Vintage V-twin, c. 1915 to 1930, left side elevation
svg.desc: Loop-frame V-twin of the Harley-Davidson J and Indian Powerplus era: inlet-over-exhaust 45 degree twin, magneto ignition, springer front fork, rigid rear, flat-sided tank with hand gear shift, foot clutch, footboards, acetylene headlamp and chain drive.

g.text: rocker pedal: heel in, toe out
three speeds, gate on the tank
primary in a case, final drive open
